missions.phrase: Мы быстро спускаемся вниз по лестнице.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Direction of motion. 'Вниз' is an adverb of direction marking downward movement. It modifies 'спускаемся' and answers куда, not где. The motion goes from a higher point toward a lower one.
Strategic focus: Directing the gaze downward. 'Вниз' shows the direction of looking after 'посмотри'. It marks where the gaze travels, not a static position. A natural everyday command.
Strategic focus: Rolling motion downward. 'Вниз' modifies 'покатился' to show the ball moving from high to low. The adverb names the trajectory, reinforced by 'по холму'.

missions.phrase: Лифт едет вниз на первый этаж.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Descending movement. 'Вниз' marks the downward direction of the lift. It modifies 'едет' and answers куда, while 'на первый этаж' names the destination.

missions.phrase: Не смотри вниз с такой высоты.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Negated downward gaze. 'Вниз' still names the direction of looking even under negation. It modifies 'не смотри', and the advice fits an everyday cautionary register.
Strategic focus: Flowing downward. 'Вниз' marks the direction of the water's movement, modifying 'стекает'. The adverb stresses motion downward rather than a fixed location.

missions.phrase: Он медленно пошёл вниз в подвал.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Walking downward. 'Вниз' shows the downward direction of 'пошёл', and 'в подвал' adds the goal. The adverb and the prepositional phrase together trace the descent.
Strategic focus: Movement of body parts downward. 'Вниз' marks the direction in which the hands move after 'опусти'. It clarifies the trajectory of the lowering gesture.

missions.phrase: Самолёт начал снижаться вниз к земле.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Descent toward the ground. 'Вниз' reinforces the downward direction of 'снижаться', and 'к земле' names the goal. The adverb keeps the focus on downward motion.

missions.phrase: Дорога идёт круто вниз к морю.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: A path leading downward. 'Вниз' describes the downward course of the road, modifying 'идёт'. Even without a moving person, the adverb conveys a downward trajectory toward the sea.
